provenance.source: Research workflow plan, section 11: chosen research question brief

scope.title: Digital patient records after donor-funded pilots
scope.domain: Why do many small clinics in low-resource settings stop using digital patient records after donor-funded pilots end, and what has kept some systems in use?
scope.observations: Pilot reports usually describe successful rollouts. Later follow-ups are harder to find.
offLimits: Answers that depend on new donor funding to keep running.
scope.riskEvaluationCriteria: Separate technical, staffing, funding and governance causes, and say which evidence is measured and which is reported.
